q2_gaps: first-person plural 'we' as a speaker-referring pronoun — the antecedentless-pronoun rule enumerates he/she/they-singular, plural they/them and it, and says nothing about I/we/you, which are deictic rather than anaphoric

comitative 'with' whose object is inanimate and is not a means ('this planet formed with its star') — the with-phrase split offers only CoAgent (explicitly animate) and Instrument (the means), so a non-agentive co-participant has no listed role
temporal/aspectual 'just' ('was just in the process of forming' = barely / only then) — not the exclusive focus particle and not a minimizer, so it has no licensed carrier and is dropped
notes: Seal handling is precise: 'its star' projects only its typing while the Possession link stays sealed, exactly as the projection table requires, and the Milky Way's kind word beside the name gives the licensed type atom. (With sk_form_1 sk_star_1) is read here as the preposition-named oblique fallback rather than an invented head.
